caption: The drawing depicts a pair of metallic, ornate objects that appear to be symmetrical and connected at a central joint. Each piece features a series of oval and circular rings at one end, with a more elaborate, decorative section featuring circular motifs and engraved patterns towards the other. The objects have an overall brownish-bronze coloration, with hints of greenish oxidation, indicative of aged metal. They are positioned diagonally across a plain off-white background, with the larger decorative ends facing the left and the looped ring ends toward the right. The composition is clean, with no surrounding objects and minimal background details, allowing the focus to remain entirely on the metallic objects.
title: Wrought Iron Bit
